---
title: AI discovery files
description: Understand the generated llms.txt, llms-full.txt, skill.md, and MCP discovery files on published docs sites.
icon: file-search
---

DubStack publishes AI-readable files for every public docs site so agents can discover current documentation without scraping the site shell.

These files are generated from the published docs navigation and content. They update when the site is republished.

## Generated files

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/llms.txt` | Compact index of public docs pages, page descriptions, and declared OpenAPI specs. |
| `/llms-full.txt` | Deduplicated full-page content bundle for tools that ingest larger text files. |
| `/skill.md` | Agent instructions that describe how to use the docs site and its MCP server. |
| `/mcp` | Public MCP server endpoint and discovery response. |
| `/.well-known/mcp` | MCP discovery document for tools that auto-detect servers. |
| `/.well-known/mcp.json` | JSON alias for the MCP discovery document. |
| `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json` | Tool metadata and safety annotations for the public MCP server. |
| `/.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json` | Server-card list for clients that expect multiple MCP endpoints. |
| `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` | Recommended skill discovery manifest with integrity metadata. |
| `/.well-known/skills/index.json` | Compatibility skills index. |
| `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | Agent card that describes the docs site and links to available skills. |

## `llms.txt`

`llms.txt` is the quick index.

Use it when an AI tool needs to discover the page list before deciding what to read.

```text
https://your-docs-domain.com/llms.txt
```

It contains:

- the site title
- the site description
- a link to `/llms-full.txt`
- public page links from the published navigation
- page descriptions from frontmatter when available
- generated API endpoint descriptions from OpenAPI operation metadata when frontmatter descriptions are absent
- declared OpenAPI spec links such as `/api-reference/openapi.json`

If the same page appears in more than one navigation tab, `llms.txt` lists the page once using the first published navigation position.

## `llms-full.txt`

`llms-full.txt` contains the rendered text content for public docs pages.

```text
https://your-docs-domain.com/llms-full.txt
```

Use it for tools that ingest a single text bundle. If the same page appears in more than one navigation tab, the full export includes that page body once.

For interactive agents, prefer the public MCP server because MCP lets the agent search and read only the pages it needs.

## `skill.md`

`skill.md` gives agents instructions for using your docs as a source of truth.

```text
https://your-docs-domain.com/skill.md
```

The generated skill points agents at:

- the public docs site
- the public MCP server
- recommended starting pages from navigation
- feedback instructions when agent feedback is enabled

If your repository includes custom skill files, DubStack serves those instead of relying only on the generated skill. See [Custom skill files](/ai/custom-skill-files).

## MCP resources

The public MCP server exposes `skill.md` as a resource. MCP clients that support resources can discover the skill without asking the user to install it separately.

## Agent discovery manifests

The agent-skills manifest is the preferred way for tools to discover hosted skill files.

```text
https://your-docs-domain.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
```

It includes a `sha256` digest for each skill file so clients can verify the content they fetch.

The compatibility skills index remains available for clients that use the original skills discovery format.

```text
https://your-docs-domain.com/.well-known/skills/index.json
```

Both indexes point to the available skill files for the site. Use the URL returned by the index instead of guessing the final skill path.

## Agent card

DubStack also publishes an agent card.

```text
https://your-docs-domain.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
```

The agent card describes the docs site, the canonical documentation URL, the supported text modes, and the skill files available for the site.

## Disable public AI discovery

AI discovery files follow the deployment's public indexing controls.

When public indexing is disabled, generated AI-readable files and public MCP discovery should return `404`.

Use this for sites that should remain public to readers but should not be exposed through machine-readable indexes.

## Protected docs behavior

Docs authentication protects AI-readable files the same way it protects rendered pages.

When password authentication is enabled:

- unauthenticated requests to `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, `/skill.md`, `/mcp`, and `.well-known` discovery files do not expose protected content
- readers must unlock the site before protected AI-readable content can be returned
- `/docs` subpath sites keep all AI discovery paths under `/docs`, such as `/docs/llms.txt` and `/docs/.well-known/mcp`
- public MCP clients without a valid reader session cannot search or read protected pages

For access-control setup, see [Docs authentication](/deployment/docs-authentication).

## Safety checklist

- Do not publish secrets, private tokens, or unreleased customer data in public docs.
- Keep page titles and descriptions specific so search and MCP results are useful.
- Use redirects when moving established pages.
- Republish after large navigation or OpenAPI changes.
- Test `/llms.txt`, `/skill.md`, `/mcp`, `/.well-known/mcp`, `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`, and `/.well-known/agent-card.json` after changing AI discovery settings.
